title: Exclusive | Nous Research Scores $90 Million to Bring Open-Source AI Assistant to Enterprises
key_facts: Nous Research, an AI company building open-source models and agents, raised a $90 million Series B at a $1.5 billion valuation.
Robot Ventures led; Nvidia, Microsoft, Samsung, Union Square Ventures, Y Combinator and Menlo Ventures took part.
Nous builds Hermes Agent, an AI assistant that gives users more control over their data.
The money will fund a move into business products, including 'Hermes for Businesses'.
The report is from the law firm Sidley's deal news; the WSJ headline calls the story an exclusive.
quote_evidence: Sidley represented Nous Research, an artificial intelligence (AI) company focused on developing open-source AI models and agents, in its US$90 million Series B financing at a valuation of US$1.5 billion.
The financing was led by Robot Ventures.
why_it_matters_hint: Shows large tech firms backing open-source AI assistants aimed at companies.
notes: WSJ original blocked; terms taken from Legal Desire, which reports Sidley's role.
